findings.bounded_remedy: Carry the held guard into preparation's trusted mutating Git helpers, preserving intentional inheritance separately from untrusted descriptor exclusion. Add a process test that pauses a preparation helper, kills its parent, and proves another owner remains excluded until that helper terminates.
findings.consequence: If the preparing parent dies while its Git helper remains alive, the permanent lock becomes available while the helper can still mutate canonical worktree topology or Git artifacts. Another owner can enter publication while those earlier mutations continue, violating the continuously held resource fence. The existing checkout-child crash test exercises the protected fixture-checkout route and does not cover this preparation window.
findings.observed_defect: Preparation's mutating Git helpers do not inherit the permanent guard. Workspace::prepare holds the guard at store.rs:541, but integrate calls command for worktree add, apply --index and write-tree. command passes no guard descriptor; the lock is close-on-exec. The separate managed_checkout_fixture route correctly uses command_guarded, but that protection does not cover preparation.

findings.bounded_remedy: Disable replacement-object interpretation consistently for Git inspection, integration, verification and commit creation. For the supported custody profile, also refuse replacement refs if their presence is unsupported, covering both loose and packed refs. Add a regression with an unchanged baseline blob replacement and an unrelated accepted delta.
findings.consequence: An admitted bare repository can contain refs/replace/X pointing to blob Y for an unchanged baseline file. Checkout and cat-file X then expose Y, so verify_worktree accepts Y and validation tests Y, while the integrated tree and prepared commit still name X. An unrelated accepted patch does not expose this through its changed-path manifest. The validation receipt can therefore claim an immutable tree whose actual object bytes were not validated.
findings.observed_defect: The new physical-worktree verification compares checkout bytes with cat-file output while Git replacement objects remain enabled. controlled and command_inner do not disable replacements, and custody.rs:320-329 rejects alternates/grafts/shallow state but permits refs/replace, including packed replacement refs.
